context: Economic news: Ren and Yuki review last year's industry figures.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: economic-report discussion; finance/production vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨年の産業全体の数字が、出ましたよ。
lines.en: Last year's overall industry figures are out.
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 生産は、どのくらい伸びましたか?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生産額は、前年より三億ほど増えました。
lines.en: Output rose by about three hundred million over the prior year.
lines.style: precise young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 消費の方は、どうだったんでしょう。
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 消費は、わずかに落ち込んでいます。
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 金融の動きが、影響したんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、金融市場が不安定でしたから。
lines.en: Yes — the financial markets were unstable.
lines.style: calm young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今年の見通しは、明るいですか?
lines.style: hopeful office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 産業界は、回復を期待しています。
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional reflective throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 生産が戻れば、消費も上がりますね。
lines.en: If production returns, consumption will rise too.
lines.style: warm office woman voice, soft warm engaged optimistic throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その通りです。来月、また確認しましょう。
lines.en: Exactly. Let's check again next month.
lines.style: agreeable young analyst voice, soft warm professional closing throughout
